name: Vonage
tagline: Cloud communications APIs for SMS, voice, video, and verify workflows.
description: Vonage (formerly Nexmo) provides programmable communications APIs for SMS, voice, video, 2FA/verify, and messaging. Developers authenticate with API key and secret (or JWT for newer APIs) and call REST endpoints to send messages, place calls, and verify users.

auth.details: API key and secret via query params or Basic auth for classic REST; JWT for newer APIs. Self-serve dashboard signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown — credit-based trial common; confirm on pricing page
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go per message/minute plus account plans

use_cases: send an SMS to a phone number
verify a user with a one-time code
make or receive a voice call
send a WhatsApp or multi-channel message
